answer: A cloned wildlife tag must not mint a second ballot. Each applicant leases one numbered nest on a published ridge transect, bound to one live key. In a 9-minute dawn slot they record one banded sparrow, then send a 40-ms induction pulse through that band into the clerk's coil. Clerks post H=blake2b(addr||nest_id||band_serial||width_us||audio_root). Fee is 0.38 POA; 18 POA bonds ten epochs. Auditors overlay the call on the nest mic and re-drive the coil on the band certificate. A doubled nest, playback call, or skipped pulse seizes the bond and blinds both keys for 15 epochs.
